tutorial.title: Find your footing
tutorial.description: Nine short steps. Learn the app, and start a paper journal you can keep without it. You finish with a badge.

journal.title: Get or make a journal
journal.description:
Any notebook works, loose sheets too. No notebook? Fold a few sheets of paper in half and staple or tie them.

Every step ends the same way. You add evidence: your own record that you did it. Here that’s a note. Tap “Add Note” and say what you’re using. Then tap “Mark complete”.

want.title: Name one thing you actually want
want.description: Something that matters to you, in your own words. Tap “Add Note” and type it. Write the same thing on the first page of your journal. Then tap “Mark complete”.

threeSteps.title: Break it into three steps you can picture
threeSteps.description: In your journal, under the thing you want, write three steps you can picture yourself doing. Small is fine. Then type them as your note.

why.title: Say why, out loud
why.description:
Record about 30 seconds on why you want this. It stays on your phone. Then write one line of why in your journal.

Rather not record? Tap “change” in the evidence box. Pick another kind, then tap Audio to turn it off.

setAside.title: Set this step aside, then pick it back up
setAside.description:
Tap “Set this step aside” under the evidence box. Stopping isn’t failing. To come back, tap “See all steps ›”, choose the step marked “Set aside”, then “Pick this back up”.

In your journal, mark one of your three steps as set aside. Then add a note here.

fiveMinutes.title: Do five minutes on your first step
fiveMinutes.description: Take the first of your three steps and spend five minutes on it. Afterwards, write what happened in your journal. Then add it here as a note.

yours.title: Make it yours
yours.description: Open the Settings tab and try each option under Theme until the app looks right for your eyes. Put your name or a mark on your journal’s cover. Then note which theme you picked.

paperOnly.title: One session on paper only
paperOnly.description:
Next time you work on your thing, leave the app shut and track it in your journal. Afterwards, come back and add a note about it. For a photo of the page, tap “Add more evidence” after your note.

Then tap “See all steps ›” to look at your timeline.

finish.title: Write the date and finish
finish.description:
Write today’s date in your journal and add a last note here. Tap “Mark complete”, then “Design your badge”. The badge is your keepsake. It says you can keep a goal journal.

After that, turn the page and tap “New goal” on the Goals tab to start your real one.
